from mcp_client import call_tool
import json, sys, re

def read_page(pid):
    res = json.loads(call_tool("confluence-gym", "get_page_by_id", {"id": int(pid), "body-format": "storage"})["result"]["content"][0]["text"])
    title = res.get("title")
    body = res.get("body", {}).get("storage", {}).get("value", "")
    clean = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', body)
    clean = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', clean).strip()
    print(f"=== PAGE {pid}: {title} ===")
    print(clean)
    print()

for pid in sys.argv[1:]:
    read_page(pid)
